Tomato___Bacterial_spot.name: Bacterial Spot
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.description: A bacterial disease causing small, water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit, leading to defoliation and sunscald.

treatments.title: Copper Spray
treatments.desc: Apply copper-based organic fungicide early morning or late evening. Repeat every 7-10 days.

treatments.title: Neem Oil
treatments.desc: Mix 2 tablespoons neem oil per gallon of water. Spray on affected areas weekly.

treatments.title: Crop Rotation
treatments.desc: Rotate crops and avoid planting tomatoes in the same spot for at least 3 years.

treatments.title: Air Circulation
treatments.desc: Prune lower branches and ensure proper plant spacing (18-24 inches apart).

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use disease-free seeds, avoid overhead irrigation, and remove infected debris.

Tomato___Late_blight.name: Late Blight
Tomato___Late_blight.description: A highly destructive oomycete disease causing large, dark, water-soaked lesions on leaves and stems.
symptoms: White fuzzy growth on leaf undersides

treatments.title: Remove Infected Plants
treatments.desc: Immediately destroy infected plants to prevent spore spread. Do NOT compost them.

treatments.title: Copper Fungicide
treatments.desc: Use fixed copper sprays as a preventative measure before symptoms appear.

treatments.title: Bacillus Subtilis
treatments.desc: Apply biological control agent Bacillus subtilis (Serenade) as an organic alternative.

treatments.title: Resistant Varieties
treatments.desc: Plant resistant varieties like Mountain Magic, Defiant, or Iron Lady.

Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Keep foliage dry, water at base, and use resistant cultivars.

Tomato___Early_blight.name: Early Blight
Tomato___Early_blight.description: A fungal disease that causes dark concentric rings on older leaves, leading to premature defoliation.

treatments.title: Compost Tea
treatments.desc: Brew and spray compost tea to boost plant immunity and add beneficial microbes.

treatments.title: Baking Soda Spray
treatments.desc: Mix 1 tbsp baking soda + 1 tsp liquid soap in 1 gallon water. Spray weekly.

treatments.title: Mulching
treatments.desc: Apply 3-4 inches of organic mulch to prevent soil splash spreading spores.

treatments.title: Pruning
treatments.desc: Remove affected lower leaves to improve air circulation.

Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Clean up all debris at season end, rotate crops, and use drip irrigation.

Tomato___healthy.name: Healthy
Tomato___healthy.description: Your tomato plant looks healthy and free of common diseases. Great job!

treatments.title: Maintain Watering
treatments.desc: Keep a consistent watering schedule — 1-2 inches per week.

treatments.title: Organic Compost
treatments.desc: Feed with balanced organic compost every 2-3 weeks during growing season.

treatments.title: Mulch
treatments.desc: Use organic mulch to retain moisture and suppress weeds.

Tomato___healthy.prevention: Continue good practices to keep your plants thriving.

Potato___Early_blight.name: Early Blight
Potato___Early_blight.description: A fungal disease causing concentric dark rings on older leaves, leading to yellowing and premature dropping.

treatments.title: Bacillus Subtilis
treatments.desc: Apply Bacillus subtilis organic spray as a biocontrol measure.

treatments.title: Copper Fungicide
treatments.desc: Use organic copper-based fungicide at first sign of symptoms.

treatments.title: Avoid Overhead Irrigation
treatments.desc: Water at the base to keep leaves dry and prevent spore spread.

treatments.title: Debris Cleanup
treatments.desc: Remove all plant debris at end of season to reduce overwintering spores.

Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Use certified disease-free seed potatoes and practice 3-year crop rotation.

Potato___Late_blight.name: Late Blight
Potato___Late_blight.description: The same devastating disease that caused the Irish Potato Famine. Rapidly destroys foliage and tubers.

treatments.title: Immediate Destruction
treatments.desc: Remove and burn infected plants immediately. Do NOT compost.

treatments.title: Copper Spray
treatments.desc: Apply copper hydroxide or copper sulfate preventatively in wet weather.

treatments.title: Hilling
treatments.desc: Hill soil high around plants to protect tubers from spore contamination.

treatments.title: Harvest Early
treatments.desc: If blight is present, harvest tubers early to prevent tuber infection.

Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant resistant varieties, avoid irrigation from above, ensure good drainage.

Potato___healthy.name: Healthy
Potato___healthy.description: Your potato plant is healthy and thriving.

treatments.title: Continue Hilling
treatments.desc: Keep hilling soil around the base to protect growing tubers.

treatments.title: Consistent Moisture
treatments.desc: Provide 1-2 inches of water per week, especially during tuber formation.

Corn___Common_rust.name: Common Rust
Corn___Common_rust.description: A fungal disease producing small, reddish-brown pustules on both leaf surfaces.
symptoms: Premature leaf death in severe cases

treatments.title: Sulfur Spray
treatments.desc: Apply organic sulfur-based fungicide at first sign of pustules.

treatments.title: Neem Oil
treatments.desc: Spray neem oil solution weekly as both preventive and curative measure.

treatments.title: Remove Infected Leaves
treatments.desc: Hand-pick and destroy heavily infected leaves.

treatments.title: Resistant Hybrids
treatments.desc: Plant rust-resistant corn hybrids for future planting.

Corn___Common_rust.prevention: Plant early, use resistant varieties, and maintain balanced nutrition.

Rice___Leaf_blast.name: Leaf Blast
Rice___Leaf_blast.description: A devastating fungal disease causing diamond-shaped lesions on leaves, reducing photosynthetic area.

treatments.title: Trichoderma
treatments.desc: Apply Trichoderma-based biocontrol agents as seed treatment and foliar spray.

treatments.title: Silicon Application
treatments.desc: Apply potassium silicate to strengthen cell walls against fungal penetration.

treatments.title: Balanced Nitrogen
treatments.desc: Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization which increases susceptibility.

treatments.title: Water Management
treatments.desc: Maintain shallow flooding and avoid drought stress.

Rice___Leaf_blast.prevention: Use resistant varieties, balanced fertilization, and proper water management.

Wheat___Septoria.name: Septoria Leaf Blotch
Wheat___Septoria.description: A fungal disease causing tan-brown lesions with dark pycnidia on wheat leaves.

treatments.title: Crop Residue Management
treatments.desc: Plow under infected crop residue to reduce inoculum.

treatments.title: Copper Spray
treatments.desc: Apply copper-based fungicide at early symptoms.

treatments.title: Resistant Varieties
treatments.desc: Plant Septoria-resistant wheat cultivars.

treatments.title: Seed Treatment
treatments.desc: Use Trichoderma-treated seed for next planting cycle.

Wheat___Septoria.prevention: Rotate crops for 2+ years, manage residue, and use certified seed.
